source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of list applications (PDF 95).

items: Data rakhna aur badalna: lists data ke collections (majmooe), jaise records, entries ya values, rakhne aur sambhalne ke liye aam istemal hoti hain. In mein item dalna, nikalna aur kisi item tak pohanchna aasan hai.

Stack aur queue banana: lists se stack (LIFO, aakhir mein aaya pehle nikle) aur queue (FIFO, pehle aaya pehle nikle) banaye ja sakte hain, jo bohat se algorithms aur computing ke kaamon ki base (bunyaad) hain. Stack aur queue sections 4.1.2 aur 4.1.4 mein hain.
Sorting aur searching algorithms: data ko order mein lagane (sorting) aur dhoondne (searching) wale algorithms aksar lists par chalte hain, jaise bubble sort, selection sort aur binary search.
Function arguments: kai values ek saath function ko bhejne ke liye list istemal hoti hai, jis se input sambhalna aasan aur flexible (lachakdar) ho jata hai.
Matrix operations: numbers aur science ke hisab mein list se matrix (numbers ki table) banaya ja sakta hai; har andar wali list matrix ki ek row (qataar) ya column hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Lists se doosre data structures kaise banaye ja sakte hain (short question 7)?
blocks.explanation: Stack: push ke liye append() aur top se nikalne ke liye pop(). Queue: peeche jorne ke liye append() aur aage se nikalne ke liye pop(0). Tree ka har node apne bachchon (children) ki list rakhta hai. Graph har vertex ke neighbours (parosiyon) ki list rakh sakta hai. Lists ki list se matrix bhi banta hai.

items: Lists data rakhti hain, stacks aur queues banati hain, sorting aur searching mein kaam aati hain, arguments bhejti hain aur matrices dikhati hain.
